chunks.text: This is sotto:
confidential, budgeted, auditable payments for AI agents.
Today, every x402 payment an agent makes is public:
chunks.say: Today, every x-four-oh-two payment an agent makes is public:

chunks.text: what it bought, from whom, and for how much.
Its strategy is readable on-chain —
and nothing caps what it can spend.
Here's a paid API.
chunks.say: Here's a paid A P I.

chunks.text: It answers 402 with both kinds of challenge in one response —
chunks.say: It answers four-oh-two, with both kinds of challenge in one response —

chunks.text: x402, and the Machine Payments Protocol —
chunks.say: x-four-oh-two, and the Machine Payments Protocol —

chunks.text: offering three rails:
Solana confidential transfers, shielded Zcash, and Tempo.
chunks.say: Solana confidential transfers, shielded Zee-cash, and Tempo.

chunks.text: Meet Capy, our demo agent.
Its owner set a policy:
at most fifty cents a payment, a dollar fifty a day.
Each quote costs twenty-five cents,
and settles as a Solana confidential transfer in under two seconds.
Six quotes in, the budget is spent —
and the seventh is refused before anything is signed.
Here are the same payments, three ways.
The public sees the transactions,
but every amount is encrypted,
and the API's public balance reads zero.
chunks.say: and the A P I's public balance reads zero.

chunks.text: The owner sees everything:
a signed receipt per payment, with the policy decision behind it.
And an auditor with the mint's auditor key
decrypts the exact amount from the ledger itself.
The proofs are found on-chain;
nothing is taken on the agent's word.
Any agent can plug in.
This is Claude Code with the sotto MCP server,
asked to buy a one-dollar research report.
It paid confidentially, and it quotes its receipt.
Agents with a shell get the same tools as an Agent Skill,
and every door shares one kill switch:
pause, and the next payment is refused.
The same policy runs on Tempo, over its native Machine Payments Protocol:
twenty-five cents, paid on the Moderato testnet —
and there it is, on Tempo's public explorer.
On Zcash, the payment is fully shielded.
chunks.say: On Zee-cash, the payment is fully shielded.

chunks.text: The API finds it with a viewing key,
chunks.say: The A P I finds it with a viewing key,

chunks.text: by the payment ID in the encrypted memo.
chunks.say: by the payment I D in the encrypted memo.

chunks.text: One owner, one ledger, three chains.
sotto: confidential, not anonymous.
Open source, and ready for any agent.
